newsitem.title: UK: Turkey expected to tap the Euromark sector - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Turkey expected to tap the Euromark sector - dealers.

text.p: Turkey is expected to launch a mark-denominated Eurobond soon, syndicate managers said on Friday.
They said six banks were in the running to lead-manage the transaction.
"The issue should be for at least 500 million marks at around a five-year maturity," a syndicate manager at a German bank in London said.
In November last year, Turkey issued a 750 million mark five-year Eurobond to yield 280 basis points over Bunds via Commerzbank and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The paper was last trading tighter at 260 b.p. over Bunds at 1545 GMT, dealers said.
Last January, Turkey launched a 500 million mark five-year Eurobond to yield 310 b.p. over Bunds via Commerzbank.
The paper was last quoted at 280 b.p. over at 1545 GMT, traders said.
Turkey said it was planning to raise $2.0 billion in international capital markets this year after a total $2.9 billion last year.
Turkey is rated Ba3 by Moody's Investors Service and B by Standard & Poor's Corp.
